_doc: Every joint in cad/sim/exo_sim.py and the real hardware that makes it. fastener_check.joint_check() checks each in Fusion: the bolt passes THREAD/HELD, every 'clamped' part is in its clamped stack (head to nut), and for each 'bearings' pair the bearing sits in the stack and the named part holds it. exo_sim.py refuses to run with a joint missing here. 'open' marks a joint whose hardware is not modelled yet (reported, not passed).
